mapper.select: SELECT "sd". ID, "sd".CREATE_TIME, "sda".AREA_ID, "sd".ENABLE_STATUS, "sd".CONNECT_STATUS, "sd".DEVICE_NAME, "sa".AREA_NAME, "sa".PID, "sd".DEVICE_IP, "sd".DEVICE_PORT, "sd".DEVICE_USERNAME, "sd".DEVICE_PASSWORD, "sd".DEVICE_CODE, "sd".PARK_ID, "sd".DEVICE_SUBTYPE, "sd".DEVICE_VENDOR, "sd".LED_SCREEN_IP, "sd".LED_SCREEN, "sd".DEVICE_TYPE, "sd".PROTOCOL_TYPE, "sd".CHANNEL_MANAGER, "sd".CHANNEL_NO, "sd".EVENT_TYPE, "sd".IS_SYNC, "sd".DEVICE_TAG, "sd".DEVICE_CAPABILITY FROM SMT_DEVICE "sd" LEFT JOIN SMT_DEVICE_AREA "sda" ON "sd". ID = "sda".DEVICE_ID LEFT JOIN SMT_AREA "sa" ON "sa". ID = "sda".AREA_ID WHERE "sd". ID = #{deviceId}
SELECT SD. ID, SD.DEVICE_NAME FROM SMT_DEVICE SD INNER JOIN SMT_DEVICE_AREA SDA ON SD. ID = SDA.DEVICE_ID WHERE SDA.AREA_ID = #{id}

SELECT D .CHANNEL_NO, SR. ID AS AREAID, SR.AREA_NAME, D .DEVICE_NAME FROM SMT_DEVICE D LEFT JOIN SMT_DEVICE_AREA SA ON D . ID = SA.DEVICE_ID LEFT JOIN SMT_AREA SR ON SA.AREA_ID = SR. ID
D.ID =#{id}

SELECT de.* FROM smt_device de INNER JOIN SMT_DEVICE_AUTHORITY_RELATION relation ON
de.ID=relation.DEVICE_ID
WHERE relation.AUTHORITY_ID=#{authId}
ORDER BY de.CREATE_TIME ASC
